text:
Marie (PM): Quick design check — proposing a slim "regression diff" layout for prompt-sets/evals. TL;DR: move primary approve CTA to the top-right, add an inline scorecard preview, and introduce keyboard shortcuts (k = approve, r = request changes). Screenshot + mock: https://figma.com/some-proto 
Sam (Design): Nice. One concern — do we lose context for long outputs? I think we should collapse long responses with a "Show more" per diff. 
Kevin (Eng): Collapse sounds good. Implementation note: rendering 150+ diffs in the DOM at once kills performance on lower-end machines. We should lazy-hydrate rows on expand. Server-side pagination for runs > 100 would help too. 
Olivia (A11y): Accessibility quick wins: ensure keyboard focus lands on the first change cell, then goes to the approve button. Bulk approve checkbox needs an aria-label. Also add aria-live region for run status updates so screen readers get notified when a run finishes. 
Nadia (QA): Scorecard peek is great but we need to surface baseline vs candidate delta inline (e.g., +1.2% / -2.3%). For bulk actions, warn if any test has a regression > 2%. 
Marie (PM): Proposed CTA copy: primary = "Approve run"; secondary = "Request changes". Short, action-oriented. Agree on showing delta inline. 
Sam (Design): I'll add a tiny legend for color-coding diffs and a compact scorecard tooltip on hover. Also suggest swapping modal confirm copy to: "Confirm bulk approve — this will approve X tests." simpler. 
Kevin (Eng): Backend gating: need an endpoint to fetch summary deltas per-test for the run view (to avoid fetching full outputs). Frontend ETA: prototype in ~4 days if we do lazy render + pagination. 
Olivia (A11y): Also request: visible focus outline on each diff row (not just checkbox). Keyboard shortcut spec: `k` = approve current diff, `j`/`k` = navigate diffs, `b` = bulk toggle. I'll draft ARIA roles and add to PR checklist. 
Nadia (QA): Edge case: what if a test has flaky non-deterministic output? We should mark flaky tests and exclude from bulk approve by default (or prompt). 
Marie (PM): Good call — add a tiny "flaky" badge and exclude from bulk by default, with override. For the alert threshold, default to 2% but admin-configurable. 
Sam (Design): I've uploaded updated mock: https://figma.com/file/compact-diff-v2 — comments enabled. Includes both slim and expanded states. 
eva-bot: prototype-note: branch created -> github.com/redwood/repo/pull/512. Preview URL: https://preview.redwood.ai/runs/1754823390/compact-diff 
Kevin (Eng): I'll put up a draft PR after the prototype. If we keep diffs lazy, memory footprint should be fine. 
Marie (PM): OK pairing plan: Sam + Kevin to build prototype, Olivia to own a11y checklist, Nadia to write test cases. We'll review in Monday design-sync. Thanks! :thumbsup:
